The '''Galactic Top 40,000''' was the compilation of the top [[Music/Legends|songs]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], one of the famed [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Eyar Marath]]'s songs was on the list.
